records.text: On September 9th, Israel bombed Qatar for no reason, violating international law
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: all of this is related to what went on on September 9th, which is that Israel bombed Qatar for no reason, violating international law, which they tend to do a lot

verification.notes: Israel did strike Doha, Qatar, on September 9, 2025, and the UN Security Council condemned the strike; EU and UN experts described it as breaching international law and Qatari sovereignty. The phrase 'for no reason' is not supported: Israel said it targeted Hamas leaders meeting in Doha. The strike and legal criticism are documented, while the assertion that there was no stated reason is contradicted.

sources.title: Israeli strike in Qatar targets Hamas leaders as they weigh Gaza ceasefire proposal
sources.relevance: Documents the September 9 strike, Israel's stated target, and Qatar's international-law objection.

sources.title: UN Security Council 9992nd meeting record, 11 September 2025
sources.relevance: Official meeting record documenting condemnation and international-law concerns about the Doha strike.

records.text: Owens said Qatar stated that it had a relationship with Hamas because the U.S. government had asked it to establish one.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And they said, the reason why we have a relationship with Hamas is because the U.S. government asked us to establish one.

verification.notes: Qatar's Ministry of Foreign Affairs reports that the prime minister said Qatar's relationship with Hamas was established 13 years earlier at the request of the United States. An earlier CBS interview also records him saying the Hamas office was established in coordination with the United States to maintain communication. These primary and direct sources verify Owens's summary of what Qatar stated; they do not imply U.S. endorsement of Hamas's actions.

sources.relevance: Official Qatari account says the Hamas relationship was forged at the request of the United States.

sources.title: Face the Nation transcript: Qatari Prime Minister Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani
sources.relevance: Direct transcript says the Hamas office was established in coordination with the United States for communication.

records.text: Candace Owens paraphrased Qatar as saying it worked with Hamas because Israel and the United States asked it to act as an intermediary, and that it was then attacked for doing what they requested.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Have they ever even done anything negative toward Israel? Well, Qatar recently came out and said, yeah, we work with Hamas because Israel and the United States asked us to. They asked us to play the intermediary. And now we are being attacked for doing what they asked us to do, which sounds like the most absolute United States Israel thing ever, is to ask people to help you and then to be like, I'm so horrified by what they're doing.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 4347.949 paraphrases a recent Qatari government response. Qatar's official news agency quotes the Foreign Ministry saying that hosting Hamas's political office occurred as part of mediation requested by both the United States and Israel and condemning Israel's attack on Qatari territory. The paraphrase accurately captures the core of that official position.

sources.title: Qatar Strongly Condemns Netanyahu's Claims on Israeli Attack Against Its Territory
sources.relevance: Official Qatari statement says the Hamas office was hosted for mediation requested by the United States and Israel and condemns the subsequent Israeli attack.

sources.title: Qatar Prime Minister address to the UN Security Council on the Israeli attack

records.text: George Farmer's Wikipedia was changed to say he had a Qatari passport or citizenship
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This is after, by the way, they changed my husband's Wikipedia and said that he was a Qatari, like he had a Qatari passport or citizenship.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 2414.067 says the Wikipedia page had been changed to add Qatari passport or citizenship language. The current article lists British and United States citizenship, but the accessible live search did not produce a preserved revision or diff containing the alleged Qatari wording. A current page cannot prove that an earlier vandalized revision never existed, so the historical-edit claim remains unverifiable rather than false.

records.text: Three couples who attended the Turning Point USA conference told Lori Cardoza-Moore they were horrified by Tucker Carlson condemning Israel and praising Qatar.
records.speaker: Laurie Cardoza-Moore

appearances.snippet: I had three couples reach out to me who had been to the Turning Point USA conference and this was in Tampa a couple weeks ago they called me and said they were horrified by what they saw horrified they saw Tucker Carlson get up and act like ... condemning Israel, ... praising Qatar with his mocking voice and his mocking laughter.

verification.notes: The public speech video establishes the event and remarks, but the statement concerns private comments attributed through Lori Cardoza-Moore to three unnamed couples. No independently attributable account corroborates those reactions.

records.text: Laura Loomer created a list of conservative influencers she believes take money from Iran, Russia, and Qatar, gave supporting evidence to the DOJ, and believes Tucker Carlson and others are likely violating FARA and deserve jail.
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: Laura Loomer jumps in and she says, I have created a list of conservative influencers who I believe are taking money from Iran, Russia, and Qatar. ... I have attached my supporting evidence. As I told the DOJ, Tucker Carlson isn't the only one who is likely violating FARA. ... All of these traitors deserve jail time. Yeah, we're still waiting for the list. She keeps alluding to it, but she never publishes it.

verification.notes: Transcript context at 45:40 identifies a quoted Laura Loomer post. Current reporting reproduces her March 15 post stating that she made a list, attached supporting evidence, told DOJ that Carlson and others likely violated FARA, and said they deserved jail. This verifies the quoted post; it does not independently establish that the undisclosed list/evidence was genuine or that any target violated FARA.

sources.relevance: Reproduces Loomer's March 15 post about her list, purported evidence, DOJ contact, FARA suspicions, and jail demand.

records.text: Laura Loomer alleged Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, David Axelrod, and Aubrey Laitsch converged in Rome for a secret anti-Trump summit and suggested it was funded by foreign money connected to Qatar
records.speaker: Laura Loomer

appearances.snippet: For a secret anti-Trump summit just days after Barack Hussein Obama's top advisor, David Axelrod, met with the Pope, Candace Owens, Nick Fuentes, and the alleged fire Turning Point USA leaker, Aubrey Laitsch, all suddenly appeared in Rome. ... A reliable source informed me that Aubrey (Aubrey Laitsch) approached several conservatives last year in an effort to recruit them to attend a paid propaganda trip to Qatar. ... I have suspicion it is all being funded by foreign dark money.

verification.notes: The source episode reads Loomers post in full, including the alleged Rome convergence of Owens, Fuentes, Axelrod, and Laitsch and her suspicion of Qatar-linked foreign funding. This verifies that Loomer made the accusation; searches found no evidence establishing a secret summit or foreign funding.
